intro: The editor is built from ten MIT-licensed packages that are versioned and released together. Seven of them (`Core` through `Rendering`) target plain `net10.0` and have no UI dependency; only `VideoSpace.Rendering` pulls in SkiaSharp. `Media`, `Controls` and `Workbench` are Uno Platform libraries targeting `net10.0-desktop` and `net10.0-browserwasm`. Every package ships symbols to NuGet.org (`.snupkg`) with SourceLink.

notes.code:
Core ← Editing, Timeline, Documents, Effects
Effects ← Audio, Rendering (+ SkiaSharp), Media (Uno)
Editing + Timeline + Rendering + Media ← Controls
Controls + Documents + Audio ← Workbench

notes.text: The browser media pipeline also contains standalone JavaScript modules (packet indexing, decoding, GPU compositing) that are not NuGet packages; [docs/libraries.md](https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/VideoSpace/blob/main/docs/libraries.md) explains their ownership and revision boundaries.

packages.description: Frame-based project model, rational time, timecode, validation and prepared indexes
summary: The document model every other package builds on: `VideoProject`, assets, tracks, clips, transitions, keyframes and captions, with exact rational frame rates and SMPTE timecode. Use it alone to generate, inspect or validate projects. No dependencies beyond .NET; no UI.
keyTypes: `VideoProject` / `Track` / `TimelineClip` / `MediaAsset` — the serializable sequence model (timeline coordinates are integer frames).
`ProjectIndex` / `TrackIndex` — prepared per-revision indexes for `At`, `TransitionAt` and `Visible` queries.

packages.description: Transactional edits, transitions, nesting, camera cuts, clipboard and undo/redo
summary: Atomic editing on top of Core: every `EditorSession.Execute` call validates the whole document and either commits one undo step or restores the previous state. Includes insert/overwrite, razor, ripple, roll, slip, rate stretch, transitions, nesting and multicamera cuts. Depends on `VideoSpace.Core`; no UI.
keyTypes: `TimelineClipboard` — value-owned `Copy`/`Paste` preserving gaps, links and transitions.

packages.description: Indexed timeline geometry, hit testing, frame snapping and anchored zoom
summary: Pixel/frame mapping for building your own timeline UI: indexed hit testing of heads, tails and bodies, snapping to edit points and markers, and zoom anchored under the pointer. Depends on `VideoSpace.Core`; renderer-agnostic, no UI.
keyTypes: `TimelineGeometry.Prepared` — attach a `ProjectIndex` for logarithmic hit tests and snapping.
`TimelineHit` / `HitPart` — `Ruler`, `Track`, `Body`, `Head`, `Tail` results with frame, track and clip IDs.

packages.description: Keyframed evaluation and backend-independent frame/audio composition plans
summary: Evaluates a project at a frame into a `FramePlan`: resolved layer transforms, color, crop, opacity envelopes, transitions, nested-sequence subplans and audio voices. Plans are plain records, so any backend (Skia, WebGPU, WebGL2) can draw them. Depends on `VideoSpace.Core`; no UI.
keyTypes: `PreparedFramePlanner` — per-revision planner with a memoized last frame; `Evaluate(frame)`.
`EffectPresets` — `Names` and `Apply` for built-in looks and animations.
`FramePlanBudget` — bounds expanded graphs before serialization or GPU allocation.

packages.description: Sample-clock PCM mixing, waveform reduction, metering and WAV export
summary: A deterministic stereo mixer that compiles gain, pan, fades, transitions, nesting and camera audio into an interval-indexed graph, then mixes arbitrary sample blocks. The host supplies decoded PCM, so no codec is pulled in. Depends on `VideoSpace.Effects`; no UI.
keyTypes: `PreparedAudioMixer` — compile once per revision; `Mix(sources, firstSample, sampleRate, stereo)`.
`PcmAudio` — caller-owned interleaved float samples with interpolated `At`.

packages.description: Validated `.videospace` manifests, SRT captions and cuts-only CMX3600 EDL
summary: File interchange: validated `.videospace` manifests, SubRip captions and a guarded cuts-only CMX3600 EDL writer that rejects what it cannot represent (transitions, nests, multicam, speed changes). Depends on `VideoSpace.Core`; no UI.
keyTypes: `EdlWriter.Write` — CMX3600 export of one video track.

packages.description: Skia frame composition, transitions, procedural footage and PNG export
summary: Draws a `FramePlan` into a host-owned `SKCanvas` (GPU or raster): transforms, color matrix, crop, vignette, dissolves/dips/wipes, nested plans, titles, captions and the procedural sample footage. Use it for native previews, thumbnails or PNG stills. Depends on `VideoSpace.Effects` and SkiaSharp; no UI framework.
keyTypes: `Palette` — hex color parsing and paint helpers.

packages.description: Uno platform boundary: local media, browser GPU presentation, audio and storage
summary: The platform boundary used by the controls: local import and project pickers, recovery storage, browser GPU presentation, Web Audio output and WebM export. In the browser it drives the bundled JavaScript modules; on desktop it provides image import, file pickers and recovery in application storage. Depends on `VideoSpace.Effects`; requires Uno Platform.
keyTypes: `BrowserState` — browser meter levels and monitor visibility.

content.text: In a browser head, include every `VideoSpace.Media/Web/*.js` file as an embedded `WasmScripts` resource, as `src/VideoSpace.App/VideoSpace.App.csproj` does.

packages.description: Custom Uno timeline, monitors, bins, panels, icons and editing fields
summary: The custom editing controls — timeline, Source/Program monitors, project bin, dockable panels, split handles, timecode/value fields, meters and vector icons — usable individually in any Uno app. Depends on `Editing`, `Timeline`, `Rendering` and `Media`; requires Uno Platform (Skia renderer).
keyTypes: `MonitorView` — frame monitor; `Update(plan, total, rate, playing, playbackRate)`, `Seek`, `Command`.

packages.description: Embeddable Uno editing workspace, effects inspector and project workflows
summary: The complete embeddable editor — menus, workspaces, Source/Program monitors, bins, timeline, Effect Controls, captions, history, playback and project/export workflows — as one `UserControl`. Depends on `Controls`, `Documents` and `Audio`; requires Uno Platform (Skia renderer).
keyTypes: `StudioWorkbench.Session` / `Timeline` — the shared session and timeline control.

content.text: Merge `StudioTheme` into the application resources as shown for Controls, and embed the Media scripts in the browser head.
